How one B2B SaaS company cut their manual reporting time by 80% and gained real-time business visibility 📊

Before working with MIFECO, their leadership team was spending 10+ hours each week manually compiling reports from Salesforce, HubSpot, Stripe, and other systems—leading to delayed decisions and inconsistent data across departments.

We built them a custom operations dashboard using our LaunchPad platform that unified all their critical business data into one real-time view. The results?
